title: How to Think in English and Stop Translating in Your Head | Speaking Practice Day 1
description:
How to think in English and stop translating in your head: Day 1 of English speaking practice you can do at home.

You understand English, but when you have to speak, your mind goes blank? You are not alone. Many learners build the sentence in their own language first, translate it, and by then the conversation has moved on.

This slow, simple English lesson shows you how to stop translating in your head and start speaking. It is not just a talk: you speak in every part. Listen to each sentence, then say it out loud in the pause.

In this lesson:
✅ Why your mind goes blank when you speak
✅ A small speaking habit for every day
✅ Thinking in English with no middle step
✅ What to do when a word will not come: use another word or describe it
✅ Shadowing: speaking like an echo
✅ Speaking without fear of mistakes
✅ A simple 15-minute daily routine

Chapters
0:00 Why your mind goes blank
3:29 A small speaking habit
7:16 English first, no middle step
11:17 Use another word

19:45 Mistakes are part of learning
